home.title: Chu Shogi
home.intro: Forty-six pieces per side. Long sliding ranks, sudden jumps, and complete Lion turns that can change direction midway.
home.profile: Rules used: Chu Shogi Renmei competition profile (2019), with the 2004 Lion clarifications. This is the best-documented current association standard, not a claim about popularity.
home.boardCaption: A measured field of twelve ranks
home.footer: A standalone Chu Shogi product · offline play and tutorials

setup.title: Set up a game
setup.intro: Saved on this device as you play. Choose an opponent or share the board.
setup.botDetail: Six fixed strengths, from a first lesson to a patient search.
setup.localNote: Both sides use the same board. Pass the device after every complete move.

free-king.description: The deepest search in this first set of bots.

atlas.title: The piece atlas
atlas.intro: Twenty-one ranks begin on the board. Eighteen promotions lead to twenty-nine distinct movement ranks; several promotions take on a rank already in the starting set.

king.name: King
king.movement: Steps one square in any direction.

lion.name: Lion
lion.movement: Can make up to two King steps in one turn, turn between landings, capture on either, or jump two squares straight.

freeKing.name: Free King
freeKing.movement: Slides any distance in any of the eight directions.

drunkElephant.name: Drunk Elephant
drunkElephant.movement: Steps one square in any direction except straight backward.

kirin.name: Kirin
kirin.movement: Steps diagonally or jumps two squares orthogonally.

phoenix.name: Phoenix
phoenix.movement: Steps orthogonally or jumps two squares diagonally.

rook.name: Rook
rook.movement: Slides any distance along a rank or file.

bishop.name: Bishop
bishop.movement: Slides any distance along a diagonal.

dragonKing.name: Dragon King
dragonKing.movement: Slides orthogonally and steps one square diagonally.

dragonHorse.name: Dragon Horse
dragonHorse.movement: Slides diagonally and steps one square orthogonally.

verticalMover.name: Vertical Mover
verticalMover.movement: Slides forward or backward; steps one square sideways.

sideMover.name: Side Mover
sideMover.movement: Slides sideways; steps one square forward or backward.

reverseChariot.name: Reverse Chariot
reverseChariot.movement: Slides any distance forward or backward.

blindTiger.name: Blind Tiger
blindTiger.movement: Steps one square in any direction except straight forward.

ferociousLeopard.name: Ferocious Leopard
ferociousLeopard.movement: Steps one square diagonally or straight forward or backward.

goldGeneral.name: Gold General
goldGeneral.movement: Steps one square orthogonally or diagonally forward.

silverGeneral.name: Silver General
silverGeneral.movement: Steps one square diagonally or straight forward.

copperGeneral.name: Copper General
copperGeneral.movement: Steps one square diagonally forward or straight backward.

goBetween.name: Go-Between
goBetween.movement: Steps one square forward or backward.

prince.name: Prince
prince.movement: Steps one square in any direction. This is a second royal piece.

soaringEagle.name: Soaring Eagle
soaringEagle.movement: Slides orthogonally and backward-diagonally; has Lion-power turns on forward diagonals.

hornedFalcon.name: Horned Falcon
hornedFalcon.movement: Slides diagonally and sideways; has Lion-power turns straight forward.

flyingOx.name: Flying Ox
flyingOx.movement: Slides vertically and on every diagonal.

freeBoar.name: Free Boar
freeBoar.movement: Slides sideways and on every diagonal.

whale.name: Whale
whale.movement: Slides vertically and on backward diagonals.

whiteHorse.name: White Horse
whiteHorse.movement: Slides vertically and on forward diagonals.

flyingStag.name: Flying Stag
flyingStag.movement: Steps one square any way; also slides forward or backward.
